$comment: The source of sf-help-mark's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/help-mark (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: The button is the native button of the sf-icon-button the template draws, with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the explanation is said through a polite status once it is open.

x-summary: A «?» beside a label that opens a short explanation on a press -- a toggletip -- announced politely, closed by Escape, a second press or a click outside.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated

events.sf-help-mark-open → opened, sf-help-mark-close → closed: they are sent after the explanation opened or closed, so they are facts and take the past form (§8, vocabulary §4); the old DOM names are dated aliases

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-help-mark beside a label whose meaning needs a sentence of explanation.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not open it on hover
Do not put essential information only behind it
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-help-mark label="Подробнее: код решения" text="Уникальное имя модуля латиницей."></sf-help-mark>

x-decisions: events (§8, vocabulary §4): sf-help-mark-open and -close were sent after the fact, so they are facts: opened and closed (sf-help-mark-opened, -closed), with the old DOM names as dated same-detail aliases until 2026-12-01. Neither is a cancelable request: the mark is a toggletip, not a layer that asks before it closes.

actions: open (waits for the explanation to be drawn) and close answer applied, also when it is already open or closed; an open whose element is removed while it draws answers cancelled. Their code is runOpen/runClose; toggle() stays a helper the template's press calls, not an action.

title -> heading: title is a property of every element (§3.1), so the setting is heading and title its dated setting alias (aliases.json). The browser's own title property is left alone; the attribute still maps.
label defaults to the language file's runtime.label («Подробнее», "More information"), read with sfWord; HELP_TEXT is gone.
key-effects: Enter and Space toggle:open (they press the native button), Escape close while it is the top open surface, Tab reach; probe.json drives Enter and Escape (gate 16).
host-states: data-open while the explanation is open (§5.3).
version 1.1.0: renamed members behind dated aliases are a minor (§4.10, §16.20).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; the content slot is the page's node, placed.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (a code's explanation) plus a heading, a content slot with a link, size 1/3 and placement top.

css-variables: eight public variables of the explanation (surface, text, border, radius, max width, padding inline and block, gap), read by its sheet with the role token as fallback and listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.
